Poultry business update: What did you miss in October 2026?

October brought a range of developments across the poultry industry, from new technology and product launches to partnerships, company changes and industry events. This month's business update also covers leadership appointments, awards and initiatives aimed at improving poultry health, farm management and sustainability. Here are some of the key stories covered by Poultry World.

Natalie KinsleyFreelance journalist

Nov 2

News

Dr. Eckel highlights AntaSync recognition and leadership transition

Dr. Eckel's AntaSync has been recognised as a novelty for the EuroTier Innovation Award 2026. The company also announced that founders Antje and Bernhard Eckel will step back from day-to-day operations at the end of 2026, with Viktor and Klara Eckel taking over in 2027.

MS Schippers expands HyCare app into Vietnam

MS Schippers has introduced its HyCare app to the Asian market, with the first poultry farms in Vietnam now connected to the digital platform. The system uses sensors, automated water monitoring and digital protocols to help farmers remotely monitor barn hygiene and identify problems early. Its expansion into Vietnam marks the start of further growth in Asia.

Chore-Time launches whole-house control system for layer farms

Chore-Time has introduced its Catalyst OVO Control, a whole-house management system designed specifically for layer operations. It integrates ventilation, feeding, lighting, egg collection and manure belt monitoring, with features tailored to free-range and organic housing. The system also allows remote monitoring via the Chore-Tronics Mobile App and can be retrofitted to existing Chore-Tronics 2 and 3 controls. 

Vostermans introduces new Multifan Venturon tunnel ventilation fan

Vostermans Ventilation has introduced the Multifan Venturon, a new 57-inch exhaust fan designed for tunnel ventilation in poultry and pig housing. Tested at BESS Labs, the fan combines high airflow, energy efficiency and durability. It is available in different versions, including a Vplus model that offers additional energy savings when used with a variable frequency drive.

DSM-Firmenich adds farm-level crop data to Sustell platform

dsm-firmenich Animal Nutrition & Health has expanded its Sustell environmental footprinting platform to allow users to incorporate their own farm-level crop production data into sustainability assessments. The new capability aims to improve the accuracy and transparency of environmental footprint calculations across the animal protein value chain and support FLAG and Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) reporting requirements.

Phileo and PhageLab partner on poultry health solutions

Phileo by Lesaffre and PhageLab have formed a strategic partnership to develop bacteriophage-based solutions targeting poultry pathogens such as Salmonella and E. coli. The collaboration will initially focus on Latin America, with plans for global expansion, aiming to improve flock health, productivity and food safety while supporting more responsible antibiotic use.

Rotem continues under Speria with established product range

Agricultural technology brand Rotem is entering a new phase as part of Speria, while retaining its distinct identity and existing product range. Its climate control and farm management solutions serve poultry houses, pig farms and greenhouses. Rotem confirms there will be no changes to its products, including its Trio, Greenfield and AC2000 controllers. The move brings its decades of agricultural technology experience into Speria’s broader offering across the food supply chain. 

World Nutrition Forum 2026 brings together over 600 delegates

More than 600 delegates gathered in Kuala Lumpur for dsm-firmenich Animal Nutrition & Health's World Nutrition Forum 2026. Under the theme “NextGEN”, discussions focused on science, innovation, digital technologies and sustainability in animal production. The event also highlighted the company's future brands, Noviwest and Panavora, and awarded Ghent University's Professor Gunther Antonissen the NextGEN Award for his contributions to poultry health research.

Poultry India Expo 2026 expects over 550 exhibitors in Hyderabad

IPEMA–Poultry India has unveiled plans for the 18th Poultry India Expo 2026 at a media event in New Delhi. The exhibition will take place from 25–27 November at the HITEX Exhibition Centre in Hyderabad, preceded by a Poultry Knowledge Day on 24 November. Organisers expect more than 550 exhibitors and 51,000 industry professionals from over 125 countries. The event will showcase developments in breeding, feed and nutrition, farm automation, ventilation, animal health and poultry processing.

Agrifirm brings animal nutrition expertise together under Nuscience brand

Royal Agrifirm Group is consolidating its specialist animal nutrition expertise under one global brand, Nuscience. The portfolio includes premixes, concentrates, farm minerals, young animal feeds, specialty feed ingredients and protein ingredients, alongside tools and services. The rollout will begin in EMEA, with Agrimprove and Earlyfeed incorporated into the portfolio and Hamlet Protein’s expertise more closely connected to the broader offering.

Novus CEO Dan Meagher receives 2026 International Visionary Award

Novus president and CEO Dan Meagher has received the 2026 International Visionary Award from Saint Louis University's Boeing Institute of International Business. The award recognises his international business leadership and contributions to the global agricultural and feed industries. Meagher has led NOVUS since 2019 and also serves as board chair of the Institute for Feed Education and Research (IFEEDER). 

Novus recognises Brazilian professor for contribution to poultry education

José Henrique Stringhini, a professor at the Federal University of Goiás in Brazil, has received the 2026 Novus International Teaching Award. Presented during the Poultry Science Association Latin American Scientific Conference in Paraná, the award recognises his contribution to poultry science education and student development. Stringhini has spent nearly 35 years at the university, teaching poultry nutrition and production, and has supervised more than 290 undergraduate, graduate and postdoctoral students during his academic career. 

Livestock Malaysia 2027 to take place in Kuala Lumpur

The 12th edition of Livestock Malaysia, an international trade show for the feed, livestock and meat industries, will take place from 10–12 August 2027 in Kuala Lumpur. Organised by Informa Markets, the event will showcase innovations in animal feed, livestock production and meat processing, while providing opportunities for industry stakeholders to network and explore business opportunities. MEREBO will coordinate the Europe, America and Australia Pavilion for international exhibitors.

Novus strengthens teams in India and Vietnam

Novus has expanded its teams in India and Vietnam with 4 appointments in animal nutrition, technical services and sales. In India, Dr Neha Karmakar, Gopu Anil Reddy and Santu Nandy take up technical and sales roles. In Vietnam, Huy Tran Cong joins as executive sales manager, bringing experience from Biochem and Alltech. The appointments strengthen Novus' regional expertise and customer support across Asia.
translationZh:
**Dr. Eckel强调AntaSync获认可及领导层交接**

Dr. Eckel的AntaSync已被认定为2026年EuroTier创新奖的新颖产品。该公司还宣布，创始人Antje和Bernhard Eckel将于2026年底退出日常运营，Viktor和Klara Eckel将于2027年接手。

**MS Schippers将HyCare应用拓展至越南**

MS Schippers已将其HyCare应用引入亚洲市场，越南首批家禽养殖场现已接入该数字平台。该系统利用传感器、自动化水监测和数字协议，帮助养殖户远程监控鸡舍卫生状况并及早发现问题。拓展至越南标志着其开始在亚洲进一步增长。

**Chore-Time为蛋鸡场推出整舍控制系统**

Chore-Time推出了Catalyst OVO Control，这是一套专为蛋鸡运营设计的整舍管理系统。它集成了通风、饲喂、照明、集蛋和粪带监控，并针对散养和有机饲养方式量身定制了功能。该系统还允许通过Chore-Tronics移动应用进行远程监控，并可改装到现有的Chore-Tronics 2和3控制器上。

**Vostermans推出新型Multifan Venturon隧道通风风机**

Vostermans Ventilation推出了Multifan Venturon，这是一款新型57英寸排风机，专为家禽和猪舍的隧道通风设计。该风机在BESS Labs进行了测试，兼具高风量、高能效和耐用性。它提供不同版本，包括Vplus型号，与变频驱动器配合使用时还可进一步节能。

**dsm-firmenich为Sustell平台增加农场级作物数据**

dsm-firmenich动物营养与健康部门扩展了其Sustell环境足迹平台，允许用户将自有农场级作物生产数据纳入可持续性评估。新功能旨在提高动物蛋白价值链环境足迹计算的准确性和透明度，并支持FLAG和科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）的报告要求。

**Phileo与PhageLab合作开发家禽健康解决方案**

Lesaffre旗下的Phileo与PhageLab建立了战略合作伙伴关系，共同开发针对沙门氏菌和大肠杆菌等家禽病原体的噬菌体解决方案。合作初期将聚焦拉丁美洲，并计划全球扩展，旨在改善鸡群健康、生产力和食品安全，同时支持更负责任的抗生素使用。

**Rotem在Speria旗下继续运营并保留现有产品系列**

农业科技品牌Rotem作为Speria的一部分进入新阶段，同时保留其独特身份和现有产品系列。其气候控制和农场管理解决方案服务于家禽舍、猪场和温室。Rotem确认其产品不会发生变化，包括Trio、Greenfield和AC2000控制器。此举将其数十年的农业技术经验纳入Speria覆盖食品供应链的更广泛产品组合中。

**2026年世界营养论坛汇聚600多名代表**

600多名代表齐聚吉隆坡参加dsm-firmenich动物营养与健康部门的2026年世界营养论坛。在“NextGEN”主题下，讨论聚焦动物生产中的科学、创新、数字技术和可持续性。活动还重点介绍了公司未来品牌Noviwest和Panavora，并授予根特大学Gunther Antonissen教授NextGEN奖，以表彰其对家禽健康研究的贡献。

**2026年印度家禽博览会预计海得拉巴550多家参展商**

IPEMA–Poultry India在新德里的一次媒体活动中公布了第18届2026年印度家禽博览会的计划。展会将于11月25日至27日在海得拉巴HITEX展览中心举行，前一天11月24日将举办家禽知识日。主办方预计将有来自125多个国家的550多家参展商和51,000名行业专业人士参加。展会将展示育种、饲料与营养、农场自动化、通风、动物健康和家禽加工方面的进展。

**Agrifirm将动物营养专长整合至Nuscience品牌**

皇家Agrifirm集团正在将其专业动物营养专长整合到一个全球品牌Nuscience旗下。产品组合包括预混料、浓缩料、农场矿物、幼畜饲料、特种饲料原料和蛋白原料，以及工具和服务。推广将首先在EMEA地区开始，Agrimprove和Earlyfeed将并入该组合，Hamlet Protein的专长将与更广泛的产品供应更紧密地连接。

**Novus CEO Dan Meagher获2026年国际远见奖**

Novus总裁兼CEO Dan Meagher荣获圣路易斯大学波音国际商务研究所颁发的2026年国际远见奖。该奖项表彰其国际商业领导力以及对全球农业和饲料行业的贡献。Meagher自2019年起领导NOVUS，同时担任饲料教育与研究所（IFEEDER）董事会主席。

**Novus表彰巴西教授对家禽教育的贡献**

巴西戈亚斯联邦大学教授José Henrique Stringhini荣获2026年Novus国际教学奖。该奖项在巴拉那举行的家禽科学协会拉丁美洲科学会议上颁发，表彰其对家禽科学教育和学生发展的贡献。Stringhini在该校工作了近35年，教授家禽营养与生产，在其学术生涯中指导了290多名本科生、研究生和博士后学生。

**2027年马来西亚畜牧展将在吉隆坡举行**

第12届马来西亚畜牧展——饲料、畜牧和肉类行业的国际贸易展——将于2027年8月10日至12日在吉隆坡举行。该活动由Informa Markets组织，将展示动物饲料、畜牧生产和肉类加工方面的创新，同时为行业利益相关者提供交流和探索商业机会的平台。MEREBO将协调欧洲、美洲和澳大利亚展馆以服务国际参展商。

**Novus加强印度和越南团队**

Novus在印度和越南扩充了团队，在动物营养、技术服务和销售方面任命了4人。在印度，Dr Neha Karmakar、Gopu Anil Reddy和Santu Nandy担任技术和销售职务。在越南，Huy Tran Cong加入担任执行销售经理，带来在Biochem和Alltech的经验。这些任命加强了Novus在亚洲的区域专业知识和客户支持。
author: Natalie Kinsley
